title: A test: carbon ore gathered at Plainrock Field (Jishui, lawless) into storage at The Crescent Moon (Mebsuta, eight jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-21 23:12 UTC (orders.log ENT-059, block ZERO: gather what the reserve lacks, carbon among the four; rules F3, F24, F36). The reserve is short of 82,321 carbon ore for the core foundry (the tool needs, 23:06 UTC); Acubens Belt, our only carbon field near home, read 406 at 22:53 UTC after 2,283 at 22:18 UTC (others mine it). Plainrock Field is a carbon-only belt: 16,042 of 30,000 at richness 31 (scouting/jishui.json, 20:12 UTC), grown from 3,888 on 2026-11-17 (about 130 an hour). No pilot of another on our record in Jishui; the nearest storage of ours is The Crescent Moon by Jadecove and Menkent (eight jumps), which keeps the road off Gliese 876 (77 pirate battles on the public record, last 2026-11-21 15:00 UTC). Stores everything, sells nothing (rule F24). One ship with an empty hold until its first RESULT line; a long haul, so the Liminal (about 150 ore a load) flies it first. 2026-11-22 11:08 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 5 -> 10. 15:10 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-064 block ZERO: loads go to the receivers by gift; requests ENT-350, ENT-351): gift to the hauler Apollo named at this station (data/fleet/receivers.json): with strict classes on each run docks, stores and gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to Logistics, which crafts them where they lie. max_ships 10 -> 8: Plainrock read 13,259 carbon at about 11:50 UTC under a pull of about 175 an ship-hour (455 ore a 156-minute run, runs.jsonl), under 8 hours of stock above min_left at 10 ships. 2026-11-22 19:20 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 8 -> 3. 2026-11-22 23:21 UTC (Zero): Plainrock read 2,840 carbon at about 21:45 UTC (census) (4,906 at 19:20 UTC with 3 ships, about 560 an hour down): max_ships 3 -> 1 and min_left 1,000 -> 2,000, so the field keeps a floor until it grows back. Carbon also stands on offer at 4 cr in depth at our home stations (Node Beta 132,103, Node Alpha 79,476, table books 23:07 UTC), so this field is not worked to its floor.
